item.text: {"iteration":1,"pcvs":[{"name":"waiting_depth","expression":"len(self.scheduler.waiting)","rationale":"Captures queue-size-dependent insertion and container growth costs."},{"name":"heap_height","expression":"int(len(self.scheduler.waiting) > 0) + int(len(self.scheduler.waiting) > 1) + int(len(self.scheduler.waiting) > 3) + int(len(self.scheduler.waiting) > 7)","rationale":"Computes heap height over the bounded workload using comparisons."},{"name":"highest_priority","expression":"int(request.priority == 0)","rationale":"Highest-priority requests can traverse more heap levels during insertion."},{"name":"empty_waiting_queue","expression":"int(len(self.scheduler.waiting) == 0)","rationale":"Distinguishes initial admission into an empty queue."}],"hypothesis":"Cost is predominantly fixed scheduler admission overhead, with variation from priority-queue insertion and container growth."}
